asset_rollback_tip3:
The above restrictions will automatically be lifted once final results are confirmed. This usually takes no longer than 6 hours.
In the meantime, you can continue using KuCoin's services. You have two options: 
(1) Wait for the blockchain to re-confirm your deposits. 
(2) Lift the withdrawal and trading restrictions due to the amount owed: you will need to deposit the amount owed into your Main Account and then {1_联系客服} to process the temporary deduction. 
Once your affected deposits are re-confirmed, KuCoin will restore your deposited assets and notify you.
